description: Diagnose and fix performance problems in Shiny for Python apps — slow startup, sluggish interactions, blocking operations, and apps that struggle beyond a handful of concurrent users. Use when a Shiny for Python app is slow, hangs, recomputes too much, times out, or must support more users; when the user asks to "speed up", "optimize", or "make faster" a Python Shiny app; or when preparing a prototyped app for real-world traffic.
